summary: The county executive explains a tax decision as a reaction to costs handed down by the state and federal governments, in the voice of a household that must pay fixed bills first.
realLife: County executives in four counties explained their tax choice by pointing to mandated services and uncertain aid. One defended raising the levy after a long stretch of holding it, one held it flat as a careful plan, one cut the rate slightly on the back of growth, and one called the tax relief good news for taxpayers and spoke straight to them.
